Business Function

Undertake support functions at local branch, collaborating with BU/SU to ensure the smooth operation of banking activities/services locally.

Responsibilities

  • Undertake or participate in fundamental internal control management tasks: internal control management for seals, keys/passwords, licenses, documents, etc.

  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
  • Capable to work effectively under pressure and tight deadlines.
  • Capable to learn and change.

PRC - DBS Chongqing Branch

Operations

Regular

The Research Analyst is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits. Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

Responsibilities

  • Responsibilities include: building financial models, writing research reports, conducting macroeconomic analysis on the global energy industry, communicating our team's ideas to institutional investors, conducting due diligence and working with Citi's product team to identify trends in the space.
  • Self-starter; used to working in a team environment and who has the ambition to progress his/her career within equity research
  • Conduct analysis
  • Make Investment Recommendations
  • Interact with Institutional Clients
  • Arrange company visits and regular management contact for investing clients and due diligence purposes
  • Attend industry conferences and speak to industry contacts
  • Track company events and earnings
  • Develop financial models and valuation techniques
  • Establish yourself as an expert
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Recommended Qualifications

  • 5-8 years previous experience
  • Distill research into an investable thesis and write report/note Market ideas to internal constituents and clients via phone calls and client marketing trips Help facilitate direct corporate access for investors Provide independent (regulatory controlled)
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses.


Education

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience


Job Family Group

Research

Job Family

Research Analysis

Time Type

Full time

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AI Architect.

Business: CTO Platforms

Job ID ： 37221

Principal Responsibilities

  • Engage and influence senior stakeholders across GCIO, Business lines and the AI leadership team to drive strategic solutions and support platform development, ensuring alignment to organisational strategy and priorities.
  • Bring thought leadership on the integration of AI capabilities into existing systems and processes, simplifying consumption, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards, for safe and measured adoption of AI.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership on the architecture and design for Group AI platform which provides fundamental AI/GenAI services and capabilities.
  • Track and translate AI/GenAI industry trends into actionable architecture decisions, identifying opportunities and risks to ensure secure adoption.
  • Introduce new practices, processes, operating model, techniques, products, services, technologies, and standards where needed, via the appropriate governance bodies and in collaboration with stakeholders in business, architecture, and engineering communities.
  • Champion AI strategy and enablement across HSBC Architecture and Engineering forums, ensuring adherence to standards, principles, and ethical/responsible use.
  • Collaborate with CTO technology domain owners to identify and position core capabilities and products within their respective roadmaps.
  • Support the innovation function in evaluating AI product vendors through review and PoC activity.

Accountabilities & Deliverables

  • Development of AI Platform reference architecture – both logical and technical, comprising data, model, compute, tooling, orchestration and governance, with detailed Architecture design of each layer
  • Create Integration architecture design that details connection of AI capability to data, applications, APIs together with integration with Cloud & system telemetry (e.g. FinOps, data assets, model consumption).
  • Define a Blueprint for platform infrastructure design comprising compute (both hybrid-cloud and on-premises), storage, networking, security and access.
  • Design Authority and deliver reusable products and architectures focused on core, high-value use of AI that meet the needs of the organization.
  • Own both, capability roadmap for centrally engineered core AI capabilities, and core AI tooling capabilities in architecture taxonomies.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Provide thought leadership within the organization, staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies relating to AI to inform strategic decision-making and secure adoption
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on AI/GenAI to cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • In-depth knowledge and experience on GenAI/Agentic AI related architectures, frameworks, and design patterns
  • Intensive hands-on engineering experience in designing and delivering AI/GenAI solutions to production
  • Strong experience in architecture design of scalable and resilience AI platform, including model lifecycle, tools, controls and AI capabilities
  • In-depth knowledge and extensive experience in senior Architecture roles within large scale, complex and internationally regulated organisations
  • Fast learning and adaptable in the rapidly evolving AI domain, quickly absorbing industry trend and new concepts and translating them into practical guidance, design and patterns
  • Understand cybersecurity, data privacy, model risk, legal, compliance and control requirements applicable to AI in the financial services industry
  • change across a global, matrixed organisation.

/WX

Job Summary

  • We are seeking an Agile Product Owner to lead a cross-functional team in designing, developing, and deploying AI solutions for our wealth and retail banking sectors. You will bridge business stakeholders, users, and technical teams to ensure AI solutions deliver maximum value and align with strategic goals.
  • The ideal candidate should understand AI concepts, technologies, and practical applications. Experience in LLM platforms & API integrations, customer experience optimization, managing RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines, model calibration, and model evaluation is essential. You will work on models across English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese languages.
  • Key responsibilities include defining and communicating the product vision and strategy for AI solutions, developing language models and collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and prioritize features. You will maintain the product backlog, lead sprint planning, and ensure the team understands tasks and objectives.
  • You will oversee the design, development, and deployment of AI solutions, ensuring they meet quality standards and deliver value. Writing clear user stories, focusing on customer experience optimization, and ensuring seamless platform integration are crucial. Tracking and analysing product performance metrics to make informed decisions is also essential.
  • Prior experience in Generative AI, Predictive Analytics & Machine Learning, Natural Language processing (NLP) and emerging technologies, running proofs of concepts, driving pilots, and product evaluations using innovative client engagement technology shall be a huge plus.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Owns the product journey, vision across the entire product life cycle, from inception, validation, build, delivery, run & iteration.
  • Maintains a commercial lens over the product, understand and communicate with relevant stakeholders on the commercial performance metrics and viability of products, and drive its adoption.
  • Creates a transparent, clear, and easy to understand product vision.
  • Owns the ‘WHY’ and ensure all members of the squad understand and embrace the vision & mission. The why should be closely aligned to the organization’s overall goals and ambitions.
  • Inspires the squad to continuously thrive in a growth mindset.
  • Sets goals for the squad and create actions plans to target for timely delivery.
  • Owns, maintains & constantly optimizes the product roadmap & product backlog.

Business

  • Act as an agile Product Owner to develop new AI solutions to drive key wealth and retail banking strategic objectives.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including technology, design, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative AI solutions.
  • Using tools like ADO to own and manage the product backlog, prioritize features based on business value, and ensure seamless delivery in an Agile environment.
  • Constantly take feedback, iterate, and improve platform and its adoption.
  • Previously defined product requirements and development roadmap based on functional expertise.
  • Strong communication skills to synchronize tasks, clarify requirements and delivery expectations with stakeholders.
  • Conducts pre-go-live demos for stakeholders and align necessary support functions to ensure a smooth transition and go-live.
  • Conducts regular retrospective and review sessions to embed a growth mindset where the squad is constantly looking for ways to improve the way we deliver products. Take learnings and share with the wider PO community.
  • Research vendor offerings, evaluate and make best recommendations.

Processes

  • Clearly aligns squad OKRs & KPIs with stakeholders and senior management, ensure these objectives and targets are well understood and aligned to the nature of your product.
  • Communicates and embed the OKRs and KPIs into every aspect of the product life cycle.
  • Identifies and maps the data sources required to validate and measure the performance of the features.
  • Performs post implementation review with squad, define measurement windows and prepare necessary data & metrics.
  • Translate data insights into prioritized product improvements.

People & Talent

  • Coaches & mentor squad members to continuously uplift capability.
  • Fosters a culture based on trust, psychological safety & collaboration.
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people.
  • Responsibility to review team capacity plans to ensure capabilities are released as per agreement with stakeholders.

Risk Management

  • Awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.
  • Is accountable for ensuring compliance and risk adherence of products and services, engage with stakeholders to ensure necessary controls are adhered to and approvals are obtained.
  • Identifies all risks and issues that may impact project viability. Track, manage and report them as per the Bank’s standards.

Governance

  • Adherence to policies and control standards, ensuring compliance and operation within risk tolerance and risk appetite
  • Maintain awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Bank operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’ within the deliverables and possessing the ability to constructively challenge relevant stakeholders and teams effectively.
  • Ability and willingness to work through details with relevant control functions in an open and collaborative manner to achieve the desired governance outcome within the bank’s risk appetite.
  • Work with global teams in Risk, Compliance and COO Office to ensure adherence to the Bank’s Risk framework, in the identification, assessment, mitigation, control and monitoring of risk.

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

  • Investment Advisors, Team Heads, Relationship Managers, (PvB and Retail)
  • Global WM Product Teams
  • Global and Country Technology teams
  • Product Owners across Digital Advisory and Client Journey
  • Country WM Product Heads
  • Group, Regional and Country WM COO teams

Other Responsibilities

  • Do the right thing: Be brave, be the change; Think client; Live with integrity
  • Never Settle: Continuously improve and innovate; Simplify; Learn from your successes and failures
  • Better together: See more in others; How can I help? Build for the long term

Skills And Experience

  • Agile Product Owner
  • Business Analysis
  • Customer Experience design and user experience principle
  • Scrum or similar Agile development methodology

Qualifications

  • The ideal candidate has a strong background in retail banking, wealth management, and Agile product management, with expertise in digital solutions, data analytics, and AI/ML. You should be data-driven, customer-centric, and skilled at navigating complex banking ecosystems.
  • 5 to 10 years of experience in digital and technology implementations, preferably within large wealth management organizations, managing complex projects.
  • 4 to 8 years of experience as an Agile Product Owner (or a similar role), with strong skills in maintaining and prioritizing a backlog.
  • Proven experience in AI/ML projects, including model development, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML tools and frameworks, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.

Job Description

The Wholesale KYC Operation (WKO) team is a global team with locations in major locations such as New York, Delaware, London, Bournemouth, Hong Kong, Singapore and China. The team owns the end to end onboarding and periodic record renewals process which involves working closely with internal stakeholders to serve as a single point. The team functions in close partnership with Sales, Operations, Credit, Legal and Compliance to ensure efficient and timely on boarding/record renewal. WKO plays a critical role in introducing new clients to our organization as well as ensuring full due diligence is done with respect to new and existing relationships. This team is responsible for the enforcement of controls associated with Know Your Client (KYC) and Anti Money Laundering (AML) regulatory requirements.

The role will consolidate the KYC profile and will ensure that all KYC and AML policies are adhered to and will be responsible for conducting reviews of client's documentation stored in internal repositories and publicly available information, initiating the necessary screening against relevant search engines and sanction lists and communicate any additional deficiencies back to the business.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the end to end onboarding process, delivering a high level of client service and relationship management.

The chosen individual will be the single point of contact for the Client during their onboarding and renewals process. They will effectively manage internal stakeholders, prioritize the pipeline through to completion, and facilitate operational performance reviews and metrics to continue to improve the client's experience with JPM.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the client on-boarding and renewal process
  • Reviews KYC records submitted by KYC Analyst for accuracy / completeness / compliance with AML, Local and Corporate Due Diligence requirements.
  • Identifies and communicates outstanding requirements or potential issues to KYC Analyst in a timely manner.
  • Review and validate documents supporting evidence to the KYC record in the system.
  • Liaises with Quality Assurance and Compliance during the Onboarding process.
  • Provide guidance and oversight to Onboarding team with respect to policies, priorities and procedures
  • Liaise with team leads within country and region to facilitate knowledge sharing
  • Identify and execute process improvements and provide support on key process and technology initiatives

Key Skills

  • Strong AML / KYC experience, with some knowledge of China regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of financial industry with expertise in multiple lines of business and client types preferred
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Chinese.
  • Ability to directly address conflicts and escalate issues where appropriate and communicate effectively with all levels of management.
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership over end to end client on-boarding process.
  • Detail-oriented with strong controls mindset and time management skills
  • Self-motivated, ability to multitask and work effectively under pressure and stress.

Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree or equivalent
  • Minimum 2-5 years' experience in financial services operations or compliance, Investment Banking, client service, and audit.

About Us

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Ready to shape Corporate Sales growth for Strategic and Focus clients?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

Corporate Sales sits within HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) and supports corporate clients with relevant products, solutions and market insight. This role focuses on serving Strategic and Focus clients, building trusted relationships and improving product penetration and wallet share. You’ll manage revenue and profitability across an allocated client portfolio while delivering a high standard of service from idea through to execution and post-trade. The role also has a strong focus on improving the cost of service delivery including shifting transactional activity towards e-capability where appropriate. Where supervisory responsibilities apply, you’ll set direction for the local Corporate Sales team and maintain a strong control environment across front office activity. Success means measurable portfolio growth, strong client feedback and consistent delivery in line with HSBC policies and regulatory expectations.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage a portfolio of Strategic and Focus corporate clients with clear ownership of revenue performance
  • Identify sales opportunities end-to-end from client need through execution and post-trade support
  • Provide day-to-day coverage across the Corporate Sales offering, coordinating with trading teams to support execution flow
  • Develop client relationships that strengthen product penetration and expand share of wallet across priority accounts
  • Partner with Relationship Managers, Global Payments Solutions (GPS) and Global Trade Solutions (GTS) to meet client needs
  • Champion adoption of appropriate service models such as migrating transactional activity to self-service e-capability
  • Coordinate with Corporate Risk Solutions (CRS) for complex balance sheet structuring solutions and cross-sell opportunities
  • Maintain an effective control environment, escalating unusual or unacceptable activity and supporting fair customer outcomes
  • Oversee team activity where supervisory responsibilities apply including performance management, coaching and resource planning
  • Adapt processes as technology platforms evolve while keeping service quality and risk controls front of mind

What We're Looking For

  • Bring strong experience in Corporate Sales including knowledge of products, clients, systems and key processes
  • Apply established understanding of capital markets including foreign exchange instruments and interest rate derivatives
  • Manage transaction flow from order through to execution in partnership with trading teams and internal stakeholders
  • Demonstrate a track record of developing client relationships that translate into revenue growth and deeper product usage
  • Partner effectively across teams and regions to deliver coordinated client coverage and consistent service
  • Operate within regulatory requirements for non-advisory sales and trading activities including holding relevant local or cross-border exams and qualifications or equivalent demonstrable experience
  • Apply sound judgement in managing conduct risk, financial crime risk and operational risk within a front office environment
  • Supervise and develop team members where applicable including performance management, coaching and maintaining quality of output

Building deeper Corporate Sales relationships

This role offers the chance to shape how HSBC supports Strategic and Focus corporate clients across products, execution and service models. You’ll be central to improving client outcomes while strengthening revenue performance and operational efficiency. Where supervisory responsibilities apply, you’ll also create clarity on standards and controls and support a consistent approach to front office supervision.

If you want your work to be measured in client trust, disciplined execution and sustainable growth this role is a strong platform to build from. Apply to help expand the HSBC Corporate Sales franchise through relationships that last and solutions that land well in market.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Development Lead to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable trading control systems that power Standard Chartered's digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
  • Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
  • Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
  • Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
  • Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning

Development & Implementation

  • Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
  • Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
  • Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
  • Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with DEV, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
  • Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
  • Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
  • Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
  • Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
  • Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Application Design, Architecture
  • Software Development
  • Leadership

Other Skills

  • AI

Qualifications

Key Experiences

  • 8+ years of experience in development with strong Java expertise, with at least 5+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
  • Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
  • Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to mentor and lead a team of engineers, fostering an environment of innovation and continuous learning.

Certifications / Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Languages

  • English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Head of Operations to establish and lead the entire operational framework for our new brokerage in China. This is a unique opportunity to build a world-class operations department from scratch. The ideal candidate will be a hands-on leader with deep expertise in China's securities market, regulatory landscape, and operational best practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing all operational processes, systems, and teams to ensure efficiency, scalability, and full compliance with Chinese regulations.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Strategy & Setup

  • Develop and execute the end-to-end operational strategy for the new brokerage.
  • Lead the setup of all operational infrastructure, including clearing, settlement, custody, and client services.
  • Select, implement, and integrate key operational systems and technologies (e.g., OMS, PMS, back-office systems, Rootnet)


Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all operations are fully compliant with regulations from the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), and other relevant authorities.
